The ride

Tackle deep sand and dramatic crests in a high-output Can-Am Maverick buggy built for speed and stability. With a low centre of gravity, long-travel suspension, and a full roll cage, buggies let you push harder with complete confidence. Take the wheel yourself or bring passengers along for the ride — every run follows a dedicated guide vehicle through open desert tracks.

  • 2-seater and 4-seater models available
  • Turbocharged Can-Am Maverick X3 performance
  • Full roll cage & 4-point racing harness
  • 30 min or 1 hour slots

Included

  • ✓ Full safety briefing & gear fitting
  • ✓ Helmets & dust goggles
  • ✓ Professional lead marshal & support escort
  • ✓ Bottled water & soft drinks
  • ✓ Sunset ridge photo pause

Requirements

  • • Driver minimum age 18 (valid driving licence or ID)
  • • Passenger minimum age 6 years
  • • Closed-toe shoes required
  • • Safety waiver signed before departure

COMMON QUESTIONS

Dune Buggy FAQ

Can passengers switch drivers during the ride?

Yes! During our ridge stop pauses, any passenger who is at least 18 years old can take over the driver’s seat.

What safety features do the buggies have?

Every Can-Am Maverick features custom welded tubular steel roll cages, 4-point racing harnesses, fire extinguishers, and full protective helmets with goggles.

Are children allowed as passengers?

Children aged 6 and above are welcome as passengers in both 2-seater and 4-seater buggies with an accompanying adult driver.

How do I get to the desert base camp?

Upon booking confirmation, we send you an exact Google Maps GPS pin directly to our desert staging camp in Lahbab, or private hotel transfer can be arranged.
